verdicts.reason: The claim matches the repo: G-1-5's next is only [F-2-4], and no visa leads to G-1-6. The legal link is real: under 난민법 제2조제3호 a humanitarian-stay holder is by definition someone not recognised as a refugee who got a stay permit from the Minister of Justice, and the 2026 manual copied into data/visadocs.yaml (&id021) covers '난민신청자 및 난민불인정자 중 인도적 체류허가자' together. The proposed fix does not work as written. G-1-5 -> G-1-6 is a sub-code move inside G-1, and G-1-6 has only an extension list, so on a scratch copy the bare edge fails tests/data.test.mjs 'a move inside Korea goes to a visa the manual lets you change to there'; the test passes once a visadocs `within` rule is added. The note also needs all four languages.
verdicts.correctedFix:
data/visamap.yaml, G-1-5:
    next:
    - F-2-4
    - to: G-1-6
      note: {en: 'Only if refugee status is refused and the Ministry of Justice grants a humanitarian stay permit instead; it is decided by the Ministry, not applied for.', ru: <translate>, uz: <translate>, uz-cyrl: <translate>}

data/visadocs.yaml, under `within:` (the manual has one extension list for G-1-5 and G-1-6, &id021):
  G-1-5>G-1-6: {use: extend, list: G-1-6}
(optionally with a four-language `notice` like the one on E-7-4>E-7-4R, saying only the sub-code changes)

verdicts.reason: H-2 has no `age` key, but that changes nothing. No visa lists H-2 in `next`, and the repo's own text says no new H-2 visas have been issued since 2026.02.12, so no edge to it should ever exist. The engine never gates the starting visa: start() checks only nationality, age 14-99 and that the code exists. So the tool never offers H-2 to a 15-year-old, and `age: [18]` would have no effect. The decree's 18+ wording could not be re-fetched either; adding the key is at most harmless data hygiene.

verdicts.reason: The facts hold: G-1-5 and G-1-6 have no in-edges and are not in NONE's list, and a refugee claim is lodged in Korea or at the port of entry. The fix is wrong. NONE moves are always from abroad, and G-1-5 has no abroad list, so NONE -> G-1-5 fails the 'move from abroad' test and would show a consular application that does not exist. In-Korea edges from B-1, B-2, D-2-2 and others fail the change-list test, because G-1-5 has only an extension list. They would also show every tourist or student an open 'Refugee applicant' option that depends on facts the engine cannot ask. tests/data.test.mjs already reads a `startOnly` key for statuses reached only by a Ministry decision; G-1 belongs there.
verdicts.correctedFix:
Add no edges to G-1-5. In data/visamap.yaml add a top-level list (the key tests/data.test.mjs:143 already reads):
# Offered only as a current visa: reached by a Ministry decision, not by an application the
# map can recommend (refugee claims: 난민법 제5조/제6조; the 2026 manual has only an extension
# list for G-1-5/G-1-6). Readers who hold one pick it as their current visa.
startOnly: [G-1]
and in the reachability test seed the BFS with the startOnly codes as well as NONE, so that F-2-4 and F-5-27 (reached only through G-1-5) count as reachable.
